title: WPA Protocolometric Signature
institution: World Protocol Academy — Institute for Protocol, Diplomacy, Public Communication & Security Studies
positioning_statement: WPA does not seek to reproduce author-identity, bibliometric, citation, social-network or general university-ranking systems. Protocolometry measures documented institutional practice in protocol, diplomacy and related professional fields through traceable public evidence, peer-context fairness, correction rights and human-governed consequential decisions.
short_signature: Evidence → Practice → Context → Measurement → Human Gate
public_tagline: We do not measure popularity. We measure documented institutional practice.
macedonian_tagline: Не мериме популарност. Мериме докажана институционална практика.

distinctive_markers.name: Institutional DNA before score
distinctive_markers.principle: Each institution is first represented through an Evidence Dossier that extracts mission, programmes, practice, research, governance, cooperation and uncertainty before any candidate score is considered.

distinctive_markers.name: NE is not zero
distinctive_markers.principle: Missing public evidence is recorded as Not Evidenced and is not silently converted into failure, estimation or penalty.

distinctive_markers.name: Practice-sensitive measurement
distinctive_markers.principle: Professional practice, simulations, applied cases, practitioner integration and knowledge transfer are measured alongside research and programme architecture.

distinctive_markers.name: Peer-context fairness
distinctive_markers.principle: A state foreign-service academy, an independent protocol academy, a university-linked school and an international training body are not treated as identical institutional species. Absolute criteria come first; peer diagnostics come second.

distinctive_markers.name: Evidence Coverage travels with the score
distinctive_markers.principle: A composite, where methodologically permitted, must be accompanied by weighted Evidence Coverage and indicator-level evidence status so that apparent precision cannot hide missing evidence.

distinctive_markers.name: Provenance and correction by design
distinctive_markers.principle: Published claims remain traceable to sources, retrieval context, methodology version and correction/dispute status.

distinctive_markers.name: Human Gate
distinctive_markers.principle: Agents may discover, extract, map, test and flag; they do not autonomously create consequential institutional rankings or final judgments.

distinctive_markers.name: Measurement before ranking
distinctive_markers.principle: Scorecards and dimension profiles are the primary outputs. Ordinal ranking is optional, downstream and separately governed rather than the purpose of the system.

non_replication_boundary.wpa_target_function: Evidence-based measurement of institutional capacity, practice, transparency and professional contribution in the specialised protocol-and-diplomacy field.

anti_mimicry_rules: Do not turn citation counts into the dominant WPA signal.
Do not turn follower counts, page traffic or social popularity into quality proxies.
Do not reward institutional fame, country power, budget size or brand prestige as hidden scoring variables.
Do not reproduce a generic university league table under a protocol label.
Do not claim 'world first', 'only system' or equivalent exclusivity without independent evidence.
Do not let paid relationships, partnerships, sponsorships or commercial status affect inclusion or scores.
recognition_goal: WPA should become recognisable for the method itself: dossier-first evidence extraction, institutional-DNA mapping, 20-indicator Protocolometry, evidence-coverage disclosure, peer-context fairness, correction rights and the Human Gate.
canonical_phrase: The WPA mark is not a number alone; it is a traceable chain from evidence to institutional practice to human-governed measurement.
